signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential split-level house across a front lawn; a large tree partially obscures the upper portion of the house and roof.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed shrubs along the foundation and a mulched tree ring look tidy, but nothing shows crew-level work such as a crew, equipment, or a landscaping vehicle.

signals.notes: Well-kept split-level home with a paved driveway curving to the left and no vehicles out; the roof is mostly hidden by the tree canopy and the house sits well back from the street.
